__readme: Cross-language golden fixture (§20.12). assemble.ts (TS test in assemble.test.ts) and mcp.rs (Rust test golden_pack_matches_fixture) must both render this dataset to golden-pack.expected.txt (dates normalized to <DATE>). Covers: pinned+source+annotation, sourceless personal block, ==highlight==, multiline content, multiline annotation, ref via refTitles, ref fallback to content snapshot, url / folder / inlined-file / not-inlined-file attachments, empty label fallback, block-level citation via refBlocks (live + dangling). Also covers a cross-project citation (b8 → b-other, foreignTitle) vs the same-project one (b6 → b1). v13 (DESIGN_CONTEXT_HYGIENE): b9 is a PINNED block the user retired (staleAt) — it must leave both the Pinned Blocks section and the Full Record, taking its slot with it, and the closing [... 1 block ...] line must appear; b10 supersedes it (↩ replaces marker, preview resolved from refBlocks even though the citee is stale); b11 corrects b2, which stays in full and grows a ⚠️ line naming #11. The label ladder (§3.2 / W7) shows up twice: b1's pinned placeholder and b6's ↩ cites: line both name b1 by its ANNOTATION, not by its first 40 characters. v14 (§9.3 拍板乙): b6 is an MCP-written block with an annotation and NO annotationBy — the pre-v14 row, resolved through its source, so it must render `ai note:`. b12 and b13 pin the two directions the recorded column exists for, both on a `· MCP` source: b12 is annotationBy 'ai' (renders `ai note:`, and its pinned placeholder must name it by its BODY — an AI note never titles a block), b13 is annotationBy 'user' (renders `note:` and its placeholder DOES use the note, because the user wrote it on an AI-written block — the case the source-only proxy gets wrong). v20 (DESIGN_MCP_INTENT_ROUTING §4.6): b10 / b11 / b12 pin the provenance sub-line. b10 carries all three fields and its recheck date has PASSED (`now` is 2025-06-15), so it must render the ⚠️ may-be-out-of-date wording while staying in the pack in full — nothing is hidden or retired. b12 carries all three with a recheck date still ahead, so it renders the plain 'recheck after' wording; it is also pinned, which pins the other half of the rule — a pinned block's Full Record PLACEHOLDER carries no provenance line, only its full rendering above does. b11 carries retrieved_at alone: the three pieces are independent and any subset renders. ⚠️ Both dates are UTC midnight and are formatted through formatUtcDate / format_utc_date, NOT the local-time formatter every other timestamp here uses.
